patterns.what_worked: Route-by-route trace of ui.start/scenario/drill-list/drill begin exposed two hidden-frame defects and a permanently missing Start Fight button; the /tmp copy mutation harness (13 mutations, all killed) kept every fix honest. The family-gated rotation slice (practice_rotation_for) was already published by all six classes but unused by the strip.
patterns.what_was_hard: The strip is a cadence preview, not the graded press schedule: the paladin grades the swing twist and the drills grade their own windows, while the preview cycles a fixed 1.5s/3.5s cadence. 8 of 14 paladin APL rows also have no art source (per-family id maps, no single spell_id). Both are class-contract follow-ups, not shared-layer guesses.
patterns.skill_gap: None in this lane; the pre-existing dead test block (section 7 after the PASS report) is a reminder to check suite report placement when auditing new pins.
